column1: # The activity bar: slug, label, icon, seat (head, top, center, bottom),
# and what a press does (space, host, modal or tell, and which). The bar
# itself is appkit's. The row seated `head` is Phigen's own mark: its
# icon is the logo, one of the two script/logo.py draws on the font
# (phigen-chat, phigen-bar); with none its first letter stands in. It
# is drawn in the window's caption, and a press on it does what its
# row names: it goes to the start, as Home does. A
# row that names nothing to do only shows its menu (data/menu.tsv); one
# that names something does that as well.
